newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke U.S. unit sells Virginia building.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke U.S. unit sells Virginia building.

text.p: Ladbroke Group Plc said on Monday its U.S. subsidiary London & Leeds Corporation, had sold its freehold interest in a development in Arlington County, Virginia, for $56.2 million.
The Ballston Station development would be sold to the State Teachers Retirement Board of Ohio, Ladbroke said in a statement.

Ladbroke said the net rental income for the eight-storey building was $5.0 million in 1995. It said London & Leeds had received $2.81 million and the balance of $53.39 million would be received on December 30.
The consideration "will be used to further reduce group debt and provide funds for investment in the group's core businesses", Ladbroke said.
